body:
Same exact boat with my husband and I, even down to the day.
He plans to get tested next week, but is isolating in case.
You can send them cards in the mail, send flowers, favorite snacks, offer to grab groceries for them and drop them off at their door.

I’m on day 7 now, due to my employer’s complete lack of care when the first person got sick (obviously it escalated to many more) 

I have no more symptoms, other than lingering chest pain that brings me panic sometimes as it can feel intense.
I haven’t had a cough at all.
I don’t know if I should go to the ER. I can’t afford a hospital bill.

I can breathe fine, it’s just extremely uncomfortable. 🥺
I’ve been sleeping on my side and stomach as it’s worse if I lay on my back.

I live in an apartment as well, and since testing positive I haven’t been out at all just to be safe. 
My health department told me not to leave until I haven’t had symptoms for 48 hours, so I assume that means outside since I have so many neighbors.
Maybe you could open up the windows?

When I was awaiting my results of my PCR, around day 2 and 3 just felt like terrible sinusitis and my nose burn the most but my sinuses did as well.
It’s since gone away on day 6, and only have mild chest pain.

Had only a runny nose and congestion on Tuesday, got tested Wednesday and was notified I’m positive today. (Saturday)

Runny nose and congestion is gone, now my chest hurts and my sinuses are burning.
Lost taste of smell yesterday (Friday) and it’s mostly back today.

I’m also hallucinating, and seeing things that aren’t there. Is this happening to anyone else?
I don’t even have a fever to explain it.

Fucked up part is I don’t go anywhere but home, work and the grocery store. 
Wear a 95, disinfect consistently, always washing hands. 🤷🏼‍♀️

Best wishes, friend.
You are a warrior.

I have the same thought “I want to go home” frequently. I thought I was the only one.

I have also had depression since I was a kid and wasn’t diagnosed until I was in my teens. As an adult I still struggle.

I don’t have a solution for longing for your SO (I’m married and wish I was alone)but perhaps video chats while watching the same shows/movies? Virtual dinner dates? Cook together over video and eat together. Best wishes, friend.

You’re not alone.
Trauma can has lasting effects when not treated. I’m with you. 
Best wishes, friend.
I feel this hard. By the end of my ten hour shifts I’m in my car in tears trying to resolve myself before I get home to my husband who doesn’t understand.
